title: Rate Guarantee and Renewal Limits by Segment, Employer Group Contracts
content:
How long contracted rates hold, how far ahead renewal rates are sent and how large a renewal increase may be are fixed per Cascade Group Dental & Vision segment for Employer Group Contracts.

| Segment | Rate guarantee for a new contract | Renewal notice | Renewal rate cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 | 12 months | 60 calendar days | 12 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 | 12 months | 60 calendar days | 12 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | 12 months | 60 calendar days | 10 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 | 24 months | 90 calendar days | 10 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | 24 months | 90 calendar days | 8 percent |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus | 24 months | 90 calendar days | 8 percent |

| Term | Value in all six segments |
|---|---|
| Rate guarantee from a renewal | 12 months |
| Mid-term rate change allowed | No |

## Definitions

- **Rate guarantee for a new contract**: the months rates are guaranteed from the effective date of a new contract.
- **Rate guarantee from a renewal**: the months rates are guaranteed from a renewal.
- **Renewal notice**: the calendar days before the renewal date by which renewal rates are sent.
- **Renewal rate cap**: an integer percent, the largest rate increase applied at a renewal under the company's schedule.
- **Mid-term rate change allowed (No)**: rates do not change during a rate guarantee except for a change in plans offered.

## The cap on both sides (hypothetical rates)

A hypothetical tier rate of 40.00 dollars renewing in a segment with a 10 percent cap may rise to at most 44.00 dollars. A renewal rate of 44.00 dollars is an increase of exactly 10 percent and stays within that cap; a renewal rate of 44.80 dollars is an increase of 12 percent, which exceeds a 10 percent cap and an 8 percent cap and stays within a 12 percent cap.
